about_the_game:
Christian stepMOTHER ✝️🔥 A short, sinful, straight-to-the-point 2D visual novel that’s basically designed for one-handed play.

Step into the shoes of the rebellious stepson 😈 living under a fire-and-brimstone pastor dad and his way-too-devoted (and way-too-hot) wife. Everything’s fine... until your stepmom drags you to a “special therapist” to pray the bad boy out of you.

What starts as awkward sessions quickly turns into the most unholy family counseling you’ve ever seen.

Why you’ll love it (and probably feel guilty after):

  • Gorgeous hand-drawn art that’s equal parts beautiful and blasphemous 🎨✝️

  • Short & sweet (or sinful) – perfect 20-40 minute goon session

  • No choices, no fluff, just one unstoppable slide into total debauchery

  • Close-ups so detailed you’ll need to confess… or keep going

⚠️ CONTENT WARNING ⚠️ Heavy blasphemy, explicit sex, corruption, religious kink, taboo themes, psychological manipulation, and zero redemption arc.

DON'T BUY IF YOU'RE A RELIGIOUS PERSON OR EASILY OFFENDED!

18+ ONLY. Not for the faint of heart (or soul). Perfect for fans of: quick faps, corruption stories, and pressing “next” while whispering “forgive me”.

Ready to sin? Add to cart and let the holy spirit leave your body. 😏
